2.title: $4 Million Settlement in Suit Against Officer Who Took Nude Images From Women’s Phones

3.title: Trump administration drops Reflecting Pool vandalism charge and admits 'botched' repairs

4.title: Nirmal Purja, Renowned Mountaineer, Is Found Dead After Pakistan Avalanche
4.summary: The British-Nepali mountaineer was one of 10 climbers who were struck by an avalanche on Thursday on Broad Peak, one of the world’s highest mountains.

5.title: Italy putting nearly all major cities on highest heat alert
5.summary: Some 19 major Italian cities - including Rome, Milan and Naples - are already on red alert, and by Monday all but two will be.
